# blockly-fun, built

The blocks view of Play (`../../blocks.js`, story S-288). These files are `npm run build` of
[funground-hq/blockly-fun](https://github.com/funground-hq/blockly-fun) (its `dist/`), copied as they are:

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `blockly-fun.js` | The blocks editor as one ES module, with Blockly 13.4.0's core and English messages inside (929 KB). Loaded the first time a learner shows the blocks |
| `blockly_fun/` | The converter (Python to blocks), sent to the preview's Python with each `check` |
| `media/` | Blockly's icons and sounds |

Built from blockly-fun commit 5b0ddfe (branch `bf16-phone-list`, BF-16: the layouts wide and phone, the phone being BF-D-053's list of rows). To update: build there and copy `dist/` here whole.
Licences: blockly-fun Apache-2.0, Blockly Apache-2.0.
